_comment: ADR-057 (TASK-214, SEC-016): what __tests__/no-client-tokens.test.ts and __tests__/user-route-credentials.test.ts allow. storageKeys: the browser-storage keys client code may read or write — each with what it holds and why that is not a credential (a key or holding that names a token, secret or credential is refused outright). tokenResponses: the API responses that carry a token in their body — a machine credential issued to a machine client, never a user's session. bearerReaders: the files that read a request's Authorization header — each with the machine credential it takes and why a machine, not a user, presents it (a user route authenticates by the cookie session only, ADR-057 D8). Per repository — not synced.

bearerReaders.credential: CRON_SECRET — the jobs tick's shared secret (ADR-056 D2)
bearerReaders.reason: The scheduler (Vercel Cron, the CLI worker) is a machine with no browser and no cookie; the secret is compared in constant time and names no user.

The page proxy lets an API request that presents an Authorization header through to its route without a session cookie, so a machine client gets the route's own answer; it verifies nothing and grants nothing — the route does.
